title: Gandhi returns to India from South Africa
summary: Mohandas Gandhi landed at Bombay after more than two decades in South Africa, where he had developed his method of nonviolent resistance.
reason: Gandhi had won concessions in South Africa and was urged by Gopal Krishna Gokhale to join the Indian national movement.
significance: Gandhi went on to lead India's independence struggle; the day is marked as Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.
